_description: This file is generated by devel/generate-config-schemas. Do not edit manually - edit the script instead.
title: Configuration file to be supplied to `augur refine --config`

alignment.description: alignment in fasta or VCF format

metadata_delimiters.description: delimiters to accept when reading a metadata file. Only one delimiter will be inferred.

metadata_id_columns.description: names of possible metadata columns containing identifier information, ordered by priority. Only one ID column will be inferred.

output_tree.description: file name to write tree to.  If not provided a file will be created using the alignment or tree input path with a "_tt.nwk" suffix.

output_node_data.description: file name to write branch lengths as node data. If not provided a file will be created using the alignment or tree input path with a ".node_data.json" suffix.

use_fft.description: produce timetree using FFT for convolutions

max_iter.description: maximal number of iterations TreeTime uses for timetree inference

timetree.description: produce timetree using treetime, requires tree where branch length is in units of average number of nucleotide or protein substitutions per site (and branch lengths do not exceed 4)

coalescent.description: coalescent time scale in units of inverse clock rate (float), optimize as scalar ('opt'), or skyline ('skyline')

gen_per_year.description: number of generations per year, relevant for skyline output('skyline')

clock_std_dev.description: standard deviation of the fixed clock_rate estimate

root.description: rooting mechanism ('best', 'least-squares', 'min_dev', 'oldest', 'mid_point') OR node to root by OR two nodes indicating a monophyletic group to root by. Run treetime -h for definitions of rooting methods.

keep_root.description: do not reroot the tree; use it as-is. Overrides anything specified by '--root'/'root'.

remove_outgroup.description: Remove the outgroup supplied via '--root'/'root'. This is only valid when a single strain name has been supplied as the root.

covariance.description: Account for covariation when estimating rates and/or rerooting. Use '--no-covariance'/'no_covariance' to turn off.

keep_polytomies.description: Do not attempt to resolve polytomies

stochastic_resolve.description: Resolve polytomies via stochastic subtree building rather than greedy optimization

precision.description: precision used by TreeTime to determine the number of grid points that are used for the evaluation of the branch length interpolation objects. Values range from 0 (rough) to 3 (ultra fine) and default to 'auto'.

date_confidence.description: calculate confidence intervals for node dates

date_inference.description: assign internal nodes to their marginally most likely dates, not jointly most likely

branch_length_inference.description: branch length mode of treetime to use

clock_filter_iqd.description: clock-filter: remove tips that deviate more than n_iqd interquartile ranges from the root-to-tip vs time regression

keep_ids.description: file containing ids to keep in tree regardless of clock filtering (one per line)

vcf_reference.description: fasta file of the sequence the VCF was mapped to

year_bounds.description: specify min or max & min prediction bounds for samples with XX in year

divergence_units.description: Units in which sequence divergences is exported.

verbosity.description: treetime verbosity, between 0 and 6 (higher values more output)
